title: Runway Goal Path
description: Goal-seek over a fixed monthly startup cash model: the smallest change in price, in month-over-month revenue growth, or in burn that reaches a declared goal, ranked by least effort. The model walks a finite horizon of integer months with revenue growing from month 2 and burn held constant; the first month where cash goes below zero is the cash-out month, interpolated in basis points of a month. Four goal types (runway months, solvency through the horizon, breakeven by a month, ending cash) are met by a full grid search over three declared lever grids, ranked by half-up effort with ties by burn_cut, then price_uplift, then growth_add; the all-zero lever scenario is always reported as the baseline. Integer minor units and integer basis points only; scope limits: one revenue line, constant burn, no financing events, no churn model, and no tax.

cash_minor.description: Starting cash in integer minor units; >= 0.

monthly_revenue_minor.description: Monthly revenue in month 1, integer minor units; >= 0.

monthly_burn_minor.description: Monthly burn before any burn cut, integer minor units; >= 0.

revenue_growth_bp.description: Month-over-month revenue growth in bp; integer, >= -10000.

goal.description: Goal: type runway_months | solvent_through_horizon | breakeven_by_month | ending_cash_at_least, plus integer value.

levers.description: Three sorted non-negative integer bp grids of at most 12 values: price_uplift_bp, growth_add_bp, burn_cut_bp.

effort_weights.description: Integer weight per lever; effort is the half-up sum of weight times lever over 100.

max_candidates.description: Maximum number of ranked candidates returned; integer >= 1.

mcp_tool_definition.name: find_runway_goal_path
mcp_tool_definition.description: Goal-seek over a monthly cash model: the smallest change in price, growth or burn that reaches a runway, solvency, breakeven or ending-cash goal, ranked by least effort with ties by burn cut, then price uplift, then growth. Integer minor units and basis points, half-up rounding once per month; cash-out interpolated in basis points of a month. Refuses non-integer or negative money, growth below -10000 bp, horizons outside 1-60, unknown goal types and bad lever grids with named reasons.

input_schema_provenance: Top-level properties are exactly the policy_parameters members the kernel reads: cash_minor, monthly_revenue_minor, monthly_burn_minor, revenue_growth_bp, horizon_months, goal, levers, effort_weights, max_candidates.
author: PostOakLabs

output_example.scope_note: One revenue line, constant burn, no financing events, no churn model, and no tax. Integer minor units and integer basis points only; rounding is half-up, applied once per month step.
